description.en: Adds a Phone page to dsh web that shows a QR code; after scanning it and allowing the pairing in OpenTandem on the phone, tasks sent from OpenTandem run in this computer's dsh. Installs the OpenTandem command line and a background Runner on first use.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中新增「手机连接」页并显示二维码；手机扫码并在 OpenTandem 中允许配对后，从 OpenTandem 发出的任务会在这台电脑的 dsh 中运行。首次使用会安装 OpenTandem 命令行和后台 Runner。
